prompt: Wide lens almost on the flooded floor of a raided speakeasy, looking up, ankle-deep spilled liquor mirroring everything. Nearest the lens, face filling nearly half the frame height, a small man of 60 with a sharp hooked nose, hollow cheeks, jutting ears and thin grey hair roars at us three-quarter on, clean-shaven, shirt open at the neck, axe high above his head. Red light from the smashed bar falls full on his mouth; teal glows from the far wall. Further back and smaller: a giant blond Swede of 30, long-boned and pale-browed, axe raised, towering at left; a bald Black man of 50 with grey stubble, axe on his shoulder, at right; deep in the room a chubby baby-faced man of 19, wading, axe up in both hands. Thanks.
